name: Thiazinamium
summary: Thiazinamium metilsulfate (INN) or thiazinam is an antihistamine. The USAN is thiazinamium chloride (with a different counterion).

pharmacology.en: It blocks histamine H1 receptors and also has anticholinergic actions. Because the molecule is charged, it acts mostly outside the brain.
pharmacology.zh: 它會阻斷組織胺H1受體，也具有抗膽鹼作用。由於分子帶電，它主要在大腦以外的部位發揮作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它会阻断组织胺H1受体，也具有抗胆碱作用。由于分子带电，它主要在大脑以外的部位发挥作用。

uses.en: It has been used as an antihistamine for allergic conditions.
uses.zh: 它曾作為抗組織胺用於治療過敏性疾病。
uses.zhHans: 它曾作为抗组织胺用于治疗过敏性疾病。

sideEffects.en: Little detail has been published. Anticholinergic antihistamines as a group can cause dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation and difficulty passing urine.
sideEffects.zh: 已發表的細節很少。具抗膽鹼作用的抗組織胺這一類藥物可能造成口乾、視力模糊、便秘與排尿困難。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已发表的细节很少。具抗胆碱作用的抗组织胺这一类药物可能造成口干、视力模糊、便秘与排尿困难。

fact.en: It is a phenothiazine antihistamine with a permanently charged nitrogen atom, which makes it much harder for it to enter the brain than its uncharged relative promethazine.
fact.zh: Thiazinamium是一種吩噻嗪類抗組織胺，帶有永久帶電的氮原子，因此比不帶電的近親異丙嗪更難進入大腦。
fact.zhHans: Thiazinamium是一种吩噻嗪类抗组织胺，带有永久带电的氮原子，因此比不带电的近亲异丙嗪更难进入大脑。
